title: License a racecourse
what: Use a place as a racecourse only if the place is licensed for that purpose; race clubs may race only on days their race control body approves (s 59).

sources.title: Racing and Wagering Act 2024 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if: (a) the person intentionally uses a place as a racecourse; and (b) the place is not licensed for that purpose
